Focus on achieving cost efficiencies and better fixed cost absorption
Strong demand from both domestic and international markets

operating_notes.text: Inventory days increased to 224 in FY26 from 209 in FY25.
Debtor days decreased to 168 in FY26 from 191 in FY25.
Creditor days remained stable at 75 in FY26.
Capacity utilization at ~61% as of FY26
Strong distribution network with 436 domestic and 53 international distributors

timeline.summary: Aeroplane reported audited FY26 results with revenue of ₹2,287 Cr, PAT of ₹103.3 Cr, and improved EBITDA margin of 9.8%.
Aeroplane reported Q1FY27 results with revenue of ₹664 Cr, up 55% YoY, and PAT of ₹37 Cr, up 128% YoY, with improved margins.
